summary: Destroys all weapons and shields carried by a target within 50' when the Verbal completes; only equipment-specific protections stop it.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Only weapons and shields carried when the Verbal is completed.

properties.note: Immunities, Resistances and other protections stop it only if they specifically extend to equipment (e.g. Blessed Aura, Flame Blade); Enlightened Soul, Protection from Magic and Adaptive Protection (Flame) do not.

references.name: Blessed Aura
references.note: Example of a protection that extends to equipment.

references.name: Flame Blade
references.note: Example of a protection that extends to equipment.

references.name: Enlightened Soul
references.note: Does not extend to equipment; cannot protect from Pyrotechnics.

references.name: Protection from Magic
references.note: Does not extend to equipment; cannot protect from Pyrotechnics.

references.name: Adaptive Protection
references.note: Adaptive Protection (Flame) does not extend to equipment; cannot protect from Pyrotechnics.

clarifications.text: Only shields and weapons carried at the moment the Verbal is completed are destroyed.
Immunities, Resistances and other protections protect the equipment only if they specifically extend to equipment, such as Blessed Aura or Flame Blade.
Enlightened Soul, Protection from Magic and Adaptive Protection (Flame) do not extend to equipment and cannot protect from it.
